lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of bright circular pixel clusters forming a non-uniform grid on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity forming a grid-like pattern, with high-luminance blobs located at the nodal intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a bright upper edge and a shadowed lower gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Visible high-luminance spots distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated on the anterior and central regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller-diameter spots on the dorsal surface of the head, anterior to the first gill slit.
